observability.title: Error Groups
observability.query: SELECT timestamp, severity.text, severity.number, message, exception.type, trace.id FROM Log WHERE service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} AND severity.number >= 13 SINCE {{window}} LIMIT 1000

observability.title: Failing Spans
observability.query: SELECT timestamp, name, span.kind, server.address, http.response.status_code, otel.status_description, trace.id FROM Span WHERE service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} AND otel.status_code = 'ERROR' SINCE {{window}} LIMIT 1000

observability.title: Log Tail
observability.query: SELECT timestamp, severity.text, severity.number, message, exception.type, exception.message, trace.id FROM Log WHERE service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} AND severity.number >= 13 SINCE {{window}} LIMIT 300

metrics.title: Golden Signals
metrics.query: SELECT rate(count(http.server.request.duration), 1 minute) AS 'rpm', percentage(count(*), WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500) AS 'err5xx', percentile(http.server.request.duration, 95, 99) AS 'lat' FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} AND http.route != '/health' SINCE {{window}}

metrics.title: Pods
metrics.query: SELECT uniqueCount(k8s.pod.name) AS 'pods', latest(service.version) AS 'version' FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} SINCE 5 minutes ago

metrics.title: Routes
metrics.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', percentage(count(*), WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500) AS 'err5xx', percentile(http.server.request.duration, 95) AS 'p95' FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} AND http.route != '/health' FACET http.route SINCE {{window}} LIMIT 100

metrics.title: Dependencies
metrics.query: SELECT count(*) AS 'calls', percentage(count(*), WHERE otel.status_code = 'ERROR') AS 'errors', percentile(duration.ms, 95) AS 'p95' FROM Span WHERE service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} AND span.kind = 'client' FACET server.address SINCE {{window}} LIMIT 50

metrics.title: Orders
metrics.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE order.status = 'completed') AS 'completed', filter(count(*), WHERE order.status = 'failed') AS 'failed', filter(sum(order.total), WHERE order.status = 'completed') AS 'revenue' FROM Span WHERE name = 'Order.Complete' AND environment = {{env}} SINCE {{window}}

metrics.title: Orders by Region
metrics.query: SELECT filter(count(*), WHERE order.status = 'completed') AS 'completed', filter(count(*), WHERE order.status = 'failed') AS 'failed' FROM Span WHERE name = 'Order.Complete' AND environment = {{env}} FACET order.region SINCE {{window}} LIMIT 50

checks.name: HTTP 5xx rate
checks.query: SELECT percentage(count(*), WHERE http.response.status_code >= 500) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'http.server.request.duration' AND service.name = {{service}} AND environment = {{env}} SINCE 360 seconds ago UNTIL 60 seconds ago

checks.name: Pod restarts
checks.query: SELECT max(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total) FROM Metric WHERE metricName = 'kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total' AND k8s.pod.name LIKE '{{service:raw}}-%' SINCE 10 minutes ago
